sasha: Heads-up — after the int8 slot-coalesce kernel change landed in canary, we see a subtle mem-growth pattern with longCTX workloads. looks like KV slots are being paged more often and reuse drops over long sequences.
sasha: Repro is with transformer-xl-ish traces, 64k token sessions, batch size 1, warmup enabled.
priya: ugh. any perf numbers? latency or just memory?
sasha: Memory steadily climbs ~120MB per 10k tokens vs baseline. tail latency +5-10ms in worst cases. telemetry shows increased page faults on the slab allocator.
mike: can you paste the profiler snapshot? flamegraph or heap diff would help.
sasha: pasted below (condensed):
```
KV residency: baseline 98% -> canary 86%
page-ins/sec: baseline 12 -> canary 48
slot-frag: +18%
LSU reuse hits: -22%
```
sasha: Also seeing INT8 decode path selecting the new fused attention kernel more often; kernel selection logs show fallback to smaller-block kernels when sequence > 8k which interacts badly with slot compaction.
david: could be scheduler heuristics that prefer the fused kernel when quantized weights present. That kernel probably increases short-lived allocations for prefetched pages.
priya: any accuracy delta? we should confirm quantization didn't regress recall.
sasha: quick eval on 1k prompts: bf16 ~ baseline, int8 drop in long-context recall by ~1.3% (not huge but consistent). seems correlated with eviction frequency.
mike: possibilities: 1) kernel alloc pattern causing fragmentation -> more paging, 2) kv prefetch policy + int8 page size mismatch, 3) coalescer changed free/alloc order.
priya: steps? revert kernel selection or tighten batching heuristics?
sasha: temporary mitigation: disable fused-kernel selection for int8 model variants and force old allocator coalesce path. ran a canary, mem growth flattened but latency +3ms.
perf-bot: run perf snapshot job #2048 queued. will upload artifacts in ~15m.
david: also try turning off aggressive prefix prefetch (config: kv.prefetch_warmup=0.2 -> 0.0) — that reduced page-ins in local repro.
mike: good call. could be prefetch + smaller int8 pages causing more fragmentation. we should add a sampling telemetry field: kv.page_source (prefetch|demand) and kernel_id to correlate.
priya: can you add a small synthetic test for 50k token sessions and run BF16 vs INT8 vs BF16-quantized-to-INT8 fallback? include run with coalesce disabled.
sasha: on it. I'll post results when perf-bot finishes. tagging @ops-bot to pin the canary to dedicated pool to avoid noisy hosts.
ops-bot: pinned canary job 2048 to dedicated-qa-gpu-2. ETA 12m.
priya: also add an eval checkpoint to detect >0.5% recall drift for longctx on PRs that change kernel selection.
david: agree. and add a telemetry alert for sustained page-ins/sec > 30 for >60s.
sasha: created a short runbook: if detected -> 1) set kv.prefetch_warmup=0.0 2) force kernel selector int8.enable_fused=false 3) repro with HWM leak detector 4) upload flamegraph. will link PR.
mike: thanks — if perf-bot artifacts show fragmentation hotspots, we should try slabmap compaction patch from july branch.
sasha: noted. will test compaction patch last. any objections to reverting the kernel change from canary to reduce customer risk?
priya: revert for now + opened issue to re-evaluate kernel with quantization-aware allocator changes.
sasha: cool. I'll post the artifact links and a short postmortem once we have numbers. :thumbsup:
